Thanks, June. I've saved the draft to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) in your mailbox. Nothing has gone out. It's there for you to send.

- **Subject:** Tansley Parcel – proposed 2027 per-seat rate
- **Body:** It gives the proposed 2027 rate of $1,313 per seat, from Pree's call with the customer on 13 October. It says the rate is proposed and not yet contracted, notes that deal desk approved sharing it, and asks Tobias to keep it to the planning sheet.

One open item: Ilse Varga also asked yesterday for a mail to Tobias with the same rate, to go out from her. I took your OK as covering Pree's request only, so I haven't drafted anything for Ilse. If you want her covered too, just tell me.
